༄༅/ /chab shog gi rim pa rnams bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chab shog gi rim pa rnams bzhugs so//

lcags mor mchog gi sprul pa'i sku karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i drung du phul ba'i thog ma/ rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku yi drung du phul ba/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i bdag nyid rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i sku'i drung du/ dge legs kyi ched me tog gi phreng ba 'thor ba ni/ snyigs ma bas kyang cher snyigs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs te/ phan bde'i nyin mor byed pa'i nyi ma mchog gi sprul pa'i sku sgrib bral chos dbyings rdo rje gsum gyi gzi brjid dpal 'bar ba/ mdo khams shar gyi ri nas legs par thon pa dang*/ sngon gyi legs smon stobs po che'i mthu las da lta yab sras chabs cig par rten 'brel legs tshogs ldan ngos/ dam pa'i chos kyi sgo lan gcig min par mtha' yas pa'i tshul gyis 'byed par ye shes kyi mthu thogs pa med pa'i phrin las 'gran pa'i zla ma mchis par stsal ba'i snyan pa phyogs brgyar khyab pas/ 'di na'ang mos blo'i 'dab stong ches cher rgyas shing dang ba lags/ ched gtad kyis gsol don/ rgyal ba yab sras la phyogs gang du bzhugs kyang*/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don kho na las ci zhig /'on kyang sngar gyi bka' srol bzang po sor gnas dgos pa gzhir bcas pas/ dbus gtsang gi gdan sa chen po rnams su mnga' gsol dang*/ sku tshe mdzad phrin bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs sogs 'go ma rten 'brel gyi ched mngags yong ba 'dug pas/ thugs kyi skul byed chibs kyi kha lo dag pa'i zhing khams 'dir myur du bsgyur ba'i thugs rje'i mthu dpung nges pa 'di nas bzung*/ grub pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa ched du gtad pa dang*/ bka' gnang bdud rtsi'i char rgyun nar mar gsol rten bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas nyes rdul gyi dris dben zhing legs tshogs kyi mdangs ris bkra ba mtha' gru yongs su rgyas pa la/

'gyur med rgya gram gyi rtags bkra ba dang bcas/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco brgyad rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i thog 'bri gung bkra shis tshugs nas maṅga laṃ// dgung lo bcu bdun gyi dus mdo khams su rgyal ba karma pa la phul/// / ༈ /a ma'i drung du/ sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba yi// mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams bskyed// a ma'i sku ni nam mkha' 'dra// cung zad sngo ba'i mdangs dang ldan// a ma'i gsung ni 'brug chen 'dra// cung zad ldir ba'i sgra dang ldan// a ma'i thugs ni ri rgyal 'dra// cung zad ya yo med par ldan// bdag gi gsol don 'di ltar lags// pad 'dab cha gcig gnang bar zhu// g.yang g.yang drung pa dgongs ma khrel// dus tshes bzang por phul ba'i don// da lta nyid du 'grub par shog /myur ba nyid du 'grub par shog /rten du nya phyis thur ma phul// zhes pa dgung lo bdun gyi steng du yum drung la phul/// / ༈ /mtshungs med dkon mchog rnam rgyal rin po che'i drung du bya bral gyi zhu yig /mi bdag gi bsam tshod 'di ltar lags// bdag ming bya bral zhes pa'i don// bya bral dang bya bral lugs gnyis las// bya bral ni sprang po'i ming yin la// bya bral zhes pa 'jig rten gyi// bya bzhag kun dang bral ba yin| |sems can dmu rgod 'dul ba la// ji ltar byas kyang phan pa dka'// lhag par bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i// dred po dmu rgod 'dul bar dka'// ha ha/ mtshams kyi zhu don 'di ltar lags| |'gyur med byang sems mtshal gyi mdangs// de ni dmu rgod 'gro 'dul byed// 'bul ba brda mtshon 'di ltar lags// 'bul rgyu'i mchog ni lus ngag yid// dngos ni bkra shis kha btags dang*// bkra shis rtags mtshan man tsi sogs// lnga mtshan phul bas mnyes par mdzod// ces pa zhabs drung gis bka' bkod khyod bya bral yin zer ba la rgyu mtshan ci yod/ dmu rgod kyi 'gro ba ji ltar 'dul/

mtshal zhig kyang ster rgyu i yod// nga la 'bul ba zhig kyang gyis gsungs par rang lo bdun thog tu phul/// / ༈ /a ce skal ldan ma la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig bsdus pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po bka' drin can// 'dren mchog rje btsun chos kyi rgyal// skyabs mchog dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// ces mchod par brjod nas/ rigs rus dpal gyi mngon par mtho// 'od gsal lha yi gdung las 'khrungs// skal ldan bzang mo zhes grags pa'i// bdag la brtse sems cher ldan pa// a ce de la tho phul don// nga yi ber thul de bsnams nas// skad cig nyid la phebs par zhu// myur ba nyid du phebs par 'tshal| |sang nyin tshun la phebs par 'tshal// dgung lo brgyad kyi dus su lcam sring la'o// // ༈ /dpon slob cod pan 'dzin pa'i drung du/ lha dang mi yi ston pa che// mnyam med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku| |mtshan thos tsam gyis sdug bsngal sel// skyabs mchog dam pa'i zhabs drung du// bya bral dkon cog phun tshogs kyis// 'gyur med dad pa'i ngang nyid nas// zhu yig 'bul don 'di ltar lags| |snga sor bka' shog chibs sga dang*// li bum cha bcas 'bri rwa la// brtse bas gnang ba nyams med phebs// der yang dpon slob gsung chos sogs// smar bar bzhugs pa bka' drin che// 'dir yang thams cad bder ngos nas// dngul rdung zangs rdung grub nas su// 'phrul dang phra yi sgang la yod// snga sor yang pheb rdzu mang po mdzad// da ni mgo skor ma mdzad par// zla gsum tshun la phebs par zhu// 'grul pa su sngar thang chung gnon// zhib par gu shrī sku rdzis 'bul// ci byas mgyogs par phebs par mkhyen// gzigs rten bkra shis kha btags 'bul// zhes pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa'i mdun du dgung lo dgu yi thog tu phul// // ༈ /mkhan po rin chen sar/ bdud sde ma lus rnam̐m par 'jom̐ms mkhas pa// phunam̐ tshom̐gs ci bsam 'grub pa'i skyes bu khyod// nyer 'tshes dben zhing phrin las che ngos nas// 'di phyogs 'gyu ba'i yid ni spro bar gyur// bzang po'i tshes la sngags mdud dang bcas dge// zhes so/// /

༈ /bkra shis tshe brtan la sku rtsed phyag dal du gnang ba/ bkra shis rdzong gsar chu dpe brko ba las// tshe brtan a bos gsung 'byon dka' bar go// nga yi lan gsum bos mthar khyod nyid kyis// a lan thengs re byin na ngo mtshar gnas// ha ha/ rtsed mo lags pas khro ba ma mdzad par// 'di ru sdod la skad cha'i rnam grangs mdzod// ces so/// / ༈ /dpon slob rin po che'i drung du/ mdzes pa'i sku ni mtshan bzang du mas brgyan// snyan pa'i gsung ni dam chos sgra dbyangs sgrog /zab pa'i thugs ni bdag sogs 'gro la brtse// skyabs kyi mchog gyur dam pa'i zhabs drung du// sgur po'i zol gyis mi phyed dad ngos nas// spyi bor thal mo sbyar te 'di skad zhu// deng dus sku yi dkyil 'khor la// gang gi nyer 'tshe med pa nas// bzhugs zhes thos pas yid sems spro// 'dir yang thams cad bde spro nas// dngul gdung rin chen 'di nyid kyang*// 'grub par yun ring thogs pa med// rten la rab tu gnas pa dang*// bdag sogs rnams kyang mjal 'dod pas// glog bzhin myur du phebs par zhu/ zhu yig spyan lam smin byed du// bkra shis lha yi dar dang bcas// nyer lngar phul bas dge gyur cig/ ces so/// / ༈ /sde pa phyag mdzod la/ sngon gyi smon lam rnam dag pas// skyabs kyi mchog gyur dag dang mjal// dkon mchog rin chen bstan la zhugs// mi dge 'phral du spangs pa'i mthus// skye ba kun tu 'grogs par nges// smod don snga chad yod pa ltar// skyabs gnas dam pa 'di phyogs su// chibs sna bsgyur ba'i mthun 'gyur gyis// mtshon byed rten ldan dang bcas pa// nyer lnga zla ba bcu gcig par// rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs nas bris// zhes so/// / ༈ /mtshungs med dkon mchog rin chen gyi drung du/ grangs med bskal bar mtha' yas tshogs mang bsags// tshad med thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs nas kyang*// gang 'dul thabs kyis de la der ston mkhan// skyabs kyi mchog gyur dam pa'i snyan drung du// dad pa'i yid kyis dang ba'i thal mo sbyar// 'gyur med ngang nas zhu don 'di ltar lags// nyid ni sems can kun gyi don slad du// ngal dub med cing g.yel ba mi mnga' zhing*// bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs pa'i stobs dang ldan// bdud sde mtha' dag 'joms pa'i drag shul che// rig gnas lda la mkhas shing byang chub pa// khyod kyi yon tan brjod pa'i mtha' med kyang*// mdo tsam rang bzhin bsnyad pa lag dal lags// zhu don 'dod pa phran bu 'di ltar yod// rab byung btsun pa'i phyag la mi mdzes shing*// nged cag sngags par gzhung nas bshad pa yi// bhu thā dzo kis phul ba'i rag chung de// bdag la brtse bas gnang na ji ltar lags// dbyings yul khrel bar 'dug na mthol lo bshags| |rten dang bcas te da lta phul ba dge// 'di rnams lo bcu'i thog du lags/// /

༈ /bla ma bzod pa la/ rje sangs rgyas kun 'dus bka' drin can// mi bdag gi spyi bor rtag tu bzhugs// dus lan gcig min par brtse bas skyongs// bdag re sa'i skyabs gnas khyed min su// zhes mchod par brjod nas dris pa'i lan spring ba/ rang gzhan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// thar 'dod kyi bsam pa cher byung nas// lha dri med 'od gsal bsgrub pa la// bstan pa'i bdag po'i dbu mdzad nas// yab mes kyi yi dam srung ma rnams// nyams snang du gsal bar mjal bas spro// khyad par pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// sgrub pa'i lha mchog drang srong nyid// sangs rgyas byang sems du ma dang*// chos kyirgyal po yang yang mjal// sems rig pa'i ngos la bltas gyur kyang*| |gzugs dngos por ma grub kho thag chod// gang ltar yang dran pa'i ngo bo la// blta rgyu dang lta mkhan yang kho rang lags// rgyas zhib rang 'bri ba'i long ma khom// bsdus tsam 'di khyod kyi ngo ma chog /skya min ser min gyi sngags chung gis// ngag mtshams kyi khog nas springs pa dge// zhes dgung lo bcu gcig gi thog drang srong loka tri'i bsnyen mtshams khog nas zhu lan// // ༈ /shang gnam gling pa karma tshogs gnyis dpal grub kyis mtsho dkar nas zhu yig tshig bcad phul ba'i zhu lan/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i sgrub gnas mchog /kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di ru// gangs ris brgyan pa'i tsā ri trar// nga la 'dun pa gang de la// cal col min par 'di skad gleng*// cha lugs shākya'i rjes 'brangs nas// ja chang 'dod la sred pa dang*// nyal zhing bag med ga la rung*// bstan pa yi ni sgor zhugs nas// tha dad rje yi zhabs phyir 'brangs// da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir// nang snying phyung la bka' bzhin sgrub// dpa' bor 'dod pa'i khe drag dang*// pha rol rma 'byin sems ngan sogs// ba spu tsam zhig sdang ba na// ma ka'i na raka dmyal ba'i rgyu// tsā ri tra yi gnas mchog der// tshul bzhin dge bcu dang du longs// dza zer rnam g.yeng zad pa med// wa mar lha chos gnas der mdzod// zhwa ltar mtshan ldan spyi bor longs// zas nor 'byor tshogs spyod lam rnams// 'a le 'o ler ma btang bar// ya rab gnas tshul ma dor mdzod// rang bzhin bzang por skyes pa yang*// la lam kha cig gzhan rkyen mang*// sha shad kyis dben rang mi 'du// sa 'dir bdag 'dra bgrod dka' dman// ha le ho le'i phyi mo 'di// a la la ba'i grogs la bsrings| |slar yang sring 'os mu can 'tshal// lha rdzas zung 'brel dang bcas dge// zhes so//

// ༈ /'byor rgyas sar/ sa skyong mi yi dbang po gang de la/ nye lam yang chos kyi rgyal po chen po yi/ bang so la brten nas/ mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal thab bzang po bkra shis kyi rang bzhin du 'du bgyid pa'i dga' ston bdag gir mdzad nas/ yi ger shar ba'i bshes phrin skyes dang bcas te ma nyams par son/ nged kyang dpal zan yang gi gtsug lag khang chen po dang*/ gdan sa chen po 'og min kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod sogs/ gnas rten 'dzam gling na 'gran zla bral ba rnams la phyag bgyi ba'i slad du/ phyogs 'dir mchis pa'i skabs yin gyi/ slar yang gnas tshul zhib pa ngag thog rang nas gsal ba bzhin/ 'phros 'os kyang gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar 'tshal// zhes man tsi yug gi skyes dang bcas mgo zla ba'i gral tshes brgyad la gdan sa chen po nas maṅga laṃ// // ༈ /gtsang stod rgyal por/ bsod nams stobs kyis mngon par mtho ba gang de la/ 'bri gung pa dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ bsod nams stobs kyis mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal bu gang der zlo ba/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyi me tog du mas brgyan pa'i gzugs sku'i skye mched lta bas chog mi shes pa/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ gser ri ltar brtan zhing dgongs pa mchog tu bzang la lhun chags pa/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad la snyems pa med pa'i brtul zhugs grub pa/ rnam par dpyod pa'i me long dri mas dben pa/ gtsug lag mtha' dag gi gzugs brnyan gsal bar 'char zhing*/ 'brel ba'i gtam legs par bshad pa'i bka' nyan po'i mkhas pa'i skyes chen rnams mgu bar mdzad pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad du'ang ma rgyal ba rnams la rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing*/ dregs tshad kyis myos shing*/ rgyal ba rnams las thugs rje'i grib bsil lhag tu 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi gtam phyogs dang phyogs su grags pa'i sgra skad dbyar gyi rnga gsang gnam sa bkrums pa tsam du bsgrags shing*/

dbus gtsang gi ma rungs pa mtha' yi rgyal ngan bstan pa'i dkrug shing skye 'gro'i phung 'dre dregs pa can thams cad spa skong ba/ lugs gnyis kyi srog shing*/ srid pa'i mes po chen por 'tsho'o zhes pa ni/ 'di na'ang yid spro ba'i bdud rtsir gyur cing*/ 'phral du'ang rnam dkar dge legs kyi lam la brtson pa mi slod par bdog /slad mar yang dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir 'phral yun bde zhing skyid pa rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston spel ba'i legs mdzad rnam dkar gyi sgo 'ba' zhig gcig tu sems pa'i bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo'i dus 'da' ba dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che kho na skye dgu mtha' dag gi phan bde'i rtsa lag tu dgongs shing*/ phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du yang de nyid 'phel rgyas kyi thabs tshul rgya che ba dang*/ grangs mang ba la che thang du bskyed nas phyag bzhes su bstar ba snga mkho las mi zhan pa zhig cis kyang gal che/ dgos don du'ang rim gro srung 'khor sogs la 'bad 'bung mdzad 'tshal/ zhes yar tshes gsum la srung ba sngags mdud bkra shis pa'i dar sum bsgril bcas bkra shis tshugs nas bris so// // ༈ /tsā ri'i rdor phyag mgron gsum la/ rgyud sde du mas rab bsngags thugs kyi gnas// nye ba'i 'thung spyod de wī ko ṭa zhes// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i zhing*// gnas mchog tsā ri tra la phyag mtshal lo// zhes spyi bor blangs te/ 'bri gung pa'i gdung gi tha chung*/ dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul gru 'dir/ gnas dang nye gnas zhing dang nye zhing sogs mang dag bzhugs pa las/ lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri tra zhes nyi zla ltar grags shing 'gran zla dang bral ba der/ mnyam med skyob pa rin po che'i phrin las par mnga' gsol ba/ ma dang mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud cing sde brgyad bran du bkol bar mdzad pa'i rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa mnyos mgar chos gsum gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa chen po/

rdor phyag mgron gsum gyis dbu mdzad/ tsā ri gsar rnying gcig char ba rnams la/ rang gzhan thams cad smin grol la 'god cing don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i bkra shis smon lam zhu rten lha g.yag spus legs pa re dang*/ rnam bzhag mtshon pa tsā ri'i mi chen po las tshan bcu gsum| jo bzang gi sde dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rgyal dbang kun dga'i phyag bzhes phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i chog sgrig cung zhig bsdus pa 'di'i 'dzugs rten la/ mang ja lnga/ hang bar 'khor sdor tshab/ bre lu ma'i tshwa khal gsum/ tshogs 'khor ched g.yag gnyis/ 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sku la pho brang man tsi bkra shis rtags brgyad ma zung 'brel/ gser gdung rin po cher/ tshon rtsi dbang gi mdog can zung 'brel/ rdo rje 'dzin par bkra shis kha btags tshon dpe dmar po zung 'brel/ sngon po zung 'brel/ smad sham legs pa/ bcob dar bdun yug /gzhan pa'i rnam bzhag thes la tshon sil bcu dang*/ kha btags bcu/ mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i steng du rgyal mtshan che legs bya 'drad dngul las grub pa/ las tshan bcu gsum la g.yag so bzhi spus dag pa re/ yongs bsgril g.yag nyi shu dang bcas yod pas| |sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang 'jig rten 'dir yang rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston 'phel ba'i bkra shis smon lam rgyun mar 'tshal// zhes chu byi hor zla drug pa'i dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la bsam 'grub mkhar rtse'i sa'i char dpal 'byor sgang zhes par/ 'bri gung sgar chen bzhugs thog nas bris pa bskur ro// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mkhar rtse'i lcam dkon mchog la gnang ba/ rgyal ba shākya'i dbang pos mchog du lung bstan pa/ nā gardzu na'i ngo bor rat+na shrī'i gdung gi tha chung lha mchog ma hā ri ṣa'i rnal 'byor pa shākya'i btsun pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gtam/ khyod la gnod byed klu gong pa bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas par springs pa/ dpon sa dkon mchog nyes pa 'di'i srog lus dbang rlung dang bcas pa drang srong dri med kyis bsrungs zin pas gnod 'tshe'i sbyor ba skad cig tsam yang ma byed/

zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang phan grogs su gnas par gyis/ yi ge 'di la 'gal na bdag nyid drang srong khros pa'i khro bo zhe sdang rdo rje'i dmod pas/ khyod kyi lus sems thal bar brlag cing rnam shes kyang rdo rje'i dmyal bar bskal ba'i bar du sdug bsngal kyi char 'bebs pas nges par gyis/ dam tshig las ma 'gal na yid dang mthun par phan tshun byams pas mi 'dor bar nges/ zhes chu pho byi ba'i lo hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gsum la sgar chen nas bris// //maṅga laṃ//
